payload.title: CuTeDSL Programming Model
payload.summary: CuTeDSL is a Python DSL in NVIDIA CUTLASS 4.x, providing a low-level GPU kernel programming model consistent with CuTe C++. Compilation path:

sections.heading: Positioning
sections.gist: CuTeDSL is a Python DSL in NVIDIA CUTLASS 4.x, providing a low-level GPU kernel programming model consistent with CuTe C++.

sections.heading: @jit and @kernel Decorators
sections.gist: table columns: Caller, Callee, Allowed, Behavior

sections.heading: Three-Stage Compilation Pipeline
sections.gist: The AST preprocessor rewrites decorated functions, inserting callbacks around control flow structures to explicitly capture program structure.

sections.heading: Type System: Constexpr vs Dynamic
sections.gist: Code is **executed twice**: at **meta-programming time** (host CPU, building the kernel) and at **runtime** (GPU execution).

sections.heading: Control Flow
sections.gist: table columns: Construct, Runtime (emit IR), Compile-time (Python execution)

sections.heading: JIT Cache
sections.gist: Cache key = hash(MLIR bytecode + DSL source files + shared libraries + environment variables)

sections.heading: Autotuning GEMM
sections.gist: - `mma_tiler_mn`: MMA tile dimensions - `cluster_shape_mn`: Number of CTAs in a cluster - `use_2cta_instrs`: Whether to use 2-CTA instructions (Blackwell) - `use_tma_store`: Whether to use TMA store

```python
@cute.jit
def add_dynamic(b: cutlass.Float32):
    a = cutlass.Float32(2.0)
    result = a + b
    print("[meta]", result)             # <Float32 proxy>
    cute.printf("[gpu] %f\n", result)   # 7.000000

@cute.jit
def add_const(b: cutlass.Constexpr):
    a = 2.0
    result = a + b
 print("[meta]", result) # 7.0 (compilation)
    cute.printf("[gpu] %f\n", result)   # 7.000000
```
